name: AI Mood Playlists
author: RFLundgren
description: AI-tag-powered mood/genre playlists, forked from Mood Playlists to consume AI Auto-Tagging's tags instead of audio analysis.

navidrome_url.title: Navidrome URL
navidrome_url.description: Internal URL of your Navidrome server (e.g., http://navidrome:4533)

navidrome_user.title: Navidrome Username
navidrome_user.description: Username for Navidrome API access (Administrator required for global playlist features)

navidrome_password.title: Navidrome Password
navidrome_password.description: Password for Navidrome API access (required for scheduled tasks)

rebuild_schedule.title: Playlist Rebuild Schedule (cron)
rebuild_schedule.description: How often to rebuild playlists from current tags. Reading tags is cheap, so this can run often - hourly by default.

playlist_tag_categories.title: Tag Categories to Build Playlists From
playlist_tag_categories.description: Comma-separated tag categories from AI Auto-Tagging to auto-create playlists for - one playlist per distinct value found in each category.

genre_allowlist.title: Genres to Build Playlists For
genre_allowlist.description: Comma-separated list of genres to auto-create playlists for. Pre-filled with AI Auto-Tagging's built-in genre vocabulary - remove any you don't want a playlist for. Clearing the field entirely means no genre playlists are built.
genre_allowlist.default: rock, pop, electronic, hip hop, jazz, classical, metal, folk, country, r&b, soul, blues, reggae, punk, indie, ambient, new age, world, funk, disco, house, techno, alternative, soundtrack, experimental

mood_allowlist.title: Moods to Build Playlists For
mood_allowlist.description: Comma-separated list of moods to auto-create playlists for. Pre-filled with AI Auto-Tagging's built-in mood vocabulary - remove any you don't want a playlist for. Clearing the field entirely means no mood playlists are built.
mood_allowlist.default: happy, chill, energetic, melancholy, party, aggressive, romantic, dreamy, dark, uplifting, nostalgic, peaceful

playlist_name_prefix.title: Playlist Name Prefix
playlist_name_prefix.description: Text prepended to every auto-generated playlist name (e.g. 'AI Chill Mix'). Change this if it collides with playlist names you already have, or to personalize it. Leave blank to restore the default 'AI '.

custom_playlists.title: Custom Combination Playlists
custom_playlists.description: Optional. Define your own named playlists that combine specific genres AND moods, one per line (or separated by ';'), in the form 'Name: genre=value1,value2 | mood=value1,value2 | size=N | artist_cap=N'. Example: 'Workout Rock: genre=rock,metal | mood=energetic,aggressive'. genre/mood are each optional but at least one is required; size/artist_cap are optional and override the Tracks per Playlist / Max Tracks per Artist settings just for this playlist. See the README for the full syntax and more examples.

playlist_size.title: Tracks per Playlist
playlist_size.description: Number of tracks in each auto-generated playlist

max_tracks_per_artist.title: Max Tracks per Artist
max_tracks_per_artist.description: Maximum number of tracks from the same artist in any single playlist (0 = no limit)

similar_songs_count.title: Similar Songs Count
similar_songs_count.description: Number of similar songs to return for Instant Mix

max_concurrency.title: Max Rebuild Workers
max_concurrency.description: Number of concurrent playlist rebuild tasks.

show_dates_in_title.title: Show Dates in Playlist Names
show_dates_in_title.description: Append the generated/creation dates directly to the playlist names so they are visible in Navidrome's Web UI. If off, dates are only saved to the comment field for external apps.

enrich_playlists.title: Add Creation Dates to Playlists
enrich_playlists.description: Automatically add creation dates to all non-plugin playlists in your library.

enrich_schedule.title: Creation Date Sync Schedule
enrich_schedule.description: Cron expression for when to scan and update the creation dates on all playlists.

elements.text: Requires the AI Auto-Tagging plugin to have already tagged your library. Need help? See HELP.md.

http.reason: Call Navidrome's own Subsonic API directly when scheduled/background tasks run outside a user request context

subsonicapi.reason: Read tags and track metadata, and create/manage tag-based playlists

taskqueue.reason: Rebuild each tag's playlist in the background without blocking the scheduler

config.reason: Read user-configured playlist and connection settings
